newsitem.title: USA: Hyundai takes stake in U.S. Electricar.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai takes stake in U.S. Electricar.

text.p: U.S. Electricar Inc said Thursday Hyundai Motor Co and Hyundai Electronics Industries Co Ltd will invest $3.6 million in the firm and secure a technology license for another $2.0 million.
U.S. Electricar said the transactions are expected to close in March 1997, with $5.45 million received by the closing with the balance to be paid over six years.

"Our relationship with Hyundai is of strategic importance to our future...We are also pleased and honored that Hyundai has made our drivetrain technology its system of choice," said Roy Kusumoto, chairman of U.S. Electricar.
